title: Favourites
question: What do I follow?
readings: the pages the person starred and the searches they saved, by kind
each line opens its page, filtered as it was for a search
strengths: one click back to what someone follows, whatever its domain
read live: a star clicked in a header shows at once
avoid: for what everyone must see: that is a board's own card, not a favourite

groupByKind.description: Group the lines by kind (records, lists, searches, boards)

removable.description: A remove button on each line that has an id: the card emits `remove` and `restore` with it (QdFavoritesCard turns it on)

action: none: each line is its own gesture; with removable, a × beside it removes it, Undo puts it back
